SELECT -- MemberScheduleStatus mss.id AS mss_id, mss.status AS mss_status,
-- ClassRoomSchedule crs.id AS crs_id, crs.schedule_status AS crs_schedule_status, crs.date AS crs_date, crs.start_time AS crs_start_time,
-- CourseHistory ch.member_id AS ch_member_id, ch.member_status AS ch_member_status, ch.course_id AS ch_course_id, ch.late_enrollment AS ch_late_enrollment, ch.paid_tuition_fee AS ch_paid_tuition_fee, ch.paid_material_fee AS ch_paid_material_fee, ch.start_month AS ch_start_month,
-- Course c.title AS c_title, c.tuition_fee AS c_tuition_fee, c.material_fee AS c_material_fee FROM member_schedule_status mss inner JOIN class_room_schedule crs ON mss.schedule_id = crs.id inner JOIN course_history ch ON mss.member_id = ch.member_id AND mss.course_id = ch.course_id inner JOIN course c ON ch.course_id = c.course_id WHERE
ch.course_id = #{courseId} AND mss.status in ('RESERVED', 'ATTENDED') -- 日程変更の再計算対象（予約中・受講済みのコマのみ） and crs.schedule_status in ('OPEN') and ch.member_status !=7 ORDER BY crs.date ASC, crs.start_time ASC;
